descriptions.w3d_s20_read_row_801d6888: Appears to copy one row of a strided byte bitmap into the output buffer, doing nothing for an out-of-range row.
descriptions.w3d_s20_read_column_801d68e0: Appears to copy one column of a strided byte bitmap into the output buffer, doing nothing for an out-of-range column.
descriptions.w3d_s20_write_pixel_801d6940: Appears to store a byte at a bounds-checked position of a strided bitmap and return it, or 0 when out of range.
descriptions.w3d_s20_dispatch_indexed_801a4a90: Appears to dispatch the target selected by an item index through the handler table at offset 24 of this, or return 0.
descriptions.w3d_s20_dispatch_indexed_801a4aec: Appears to dispatch the target selected by an item index in the owner's record through the handler table at offset 24, or return 0.
